title: lampropappus turbinellus
intro: Lampropappus turbinellus, commonly known as Turnsole, is a plant species that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Lampropappus turbinellus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as protect against infections and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and analgesic effects.
